# Learning Policy

Classify learning as `OBSERVED`, `PROPOSED`, `REPRODUCED`, `VALIDATED`, `CANDIDATE`, `STABLE`, or `DEPRECATED`. A single observation never becomes an organization-wide rule.

Before proposing a lesson, remove customer identifiers, secrets, personal/commercial data, private URLs and proprietary business rules. Preserve evidence and context. If sanitization could change meaning, keep the lesson in the project. Stable publication requires review, regression validation, semantic versioning, an immutable tag, manifest and release.
